text:
Dear all, 

My partner and I are planning to have the civil wedding in Hungary soon, and once we get married, we'll start the process in order to get the A5 visa. 

Can you please let me know how long time it takes from the submission until getting the clearance from MH in order to continue the process in Israel? In our case, he'll be applying on my behalf in the North. 

We're also planning to have a symbolic ceremony once I arrive to Israel as we want to celebrate our union with his family and some friends there. 

Any help would be appreciated!

Kindly, 

Judith :)
